statements.status_notes: These Contour builds backport upstream commit 4cb1dcb459fb30f8839fe534ab594cbc58eabf50, rejecting HTTPProxy resources that combine fallback TLS certificates with JWT providers with TLSIncompatibleFeatures before their routes can be installed on the shared fallback connection manager. See https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/commit/4cb1dcb459fb30f8839fe534ab594cbc58eabf50 and https://github.com/projectcontour/contour/security/advisories/GHSA-g3xr-5w5j-w4q4.
